tests.name: Canonical tables exist (districts, parliamentary_constituencies)
tests.expected: Both tables accessible via service_role with required columns

tests.name: Additive columns exist; constituencies.id primary key preserved
tests.expected: constituencies.id preserved as VARCHAR/string; internal_id and canonical_code present

tests.name: internal_id is NOT NULL, UUID format, and UNIQUE
tests.expected: 119 valid, non-null, unique UUIDs across Telangana ACs

tests.name: canonical_code is correctly formatted and UNIQUE
tests.expected: 119 padded unique canonical codes (TS-AC-001 to TS-AC-119)

tests.name: Telangana pilot entity row counts (1 State, 33 Districts, 17 PCs, 119 ACs)
Relational integrity: 100% of 119 ACs resolve valid district_id and parliamentary_constituency_id FKs
tests.expected: Exactly 119 ACs with state_code TS resolving to existing districts.id and parliamentary_constituencies.id; 0 orphans
tests.details: All 119 Telangana ACs strictly resolve to existing District and PC primary keys.

tests.name: Pilot entity primary_dataset_version_id references and assignment semantics
tests.expected: All 170 pilot entities resolve to dataset_versions; 31 districts to 2016, 2 to 2019 additions, 17 PCs and 119 ACs to ECI 2008
tests.details: 100% of pilot entities resolve valid primary dataset versions with correct statutory/electoral semantics.

tests.name: Provenance linkage resolution test (Zero orphaned linkages)
tests.expected: Exactly 170 linkages resolving to valid domain records, valid provenance records, and UNVERIFIED status; 0 orphans
tests.details: All 170 pilot linkages bidirectionally resolve to existing domain rows and valid provenance records.

tests.name: Lineage-aware governance verification: 100% pilot lineage UNVERIFIED, zero OFFICIAL
tests.expected: 170/170 complete lineage chains verify provenance.status = UNVERIFIED and version.default_status = UNVERIFIED; 0 OFFICIAL
tests.details: Complete pilot lineage chain verified: zero records elevated to OFFICIAL, 100% strictly UNVERIFIED.

tests.name: Row Level Security enabled: public read succeeds; anonymous mutation denied
tests.expected: Public read returns 200; anonymous insertions rejected by RLS

tests.name: Existing domain read compatibility smoke test
tests.expected: HTTP 200 responses on 4 representative domain reads (states, constituencies, civic_issues, posts)
tests.details: Smoke test: confirms basic unauthenticated read availability across existing domain paths. Does not constitute exhaustive backwards-compatibility proof.

tests.name: District chronology and dataset semantics verified
tests.expected: 31 base districts from ts_districts_2016_v1; 2 addition districts (Mulugu, Narayanpet) from ts_districts_2019_additions_v1

tests.name: Canonical identifier width sufficiency (Full Jayashankar Bhupalpally length 31 verified)
tests.expected: Full untruncated code 'TS-DIST-JAYASHANKAR-BHUPALPALLY' (31 chars) successfully persisted and retrieved
